description: Use this when the user pastes an email event export (Customer.io reporting webhook, SendGrid or Mailgun events) and wants a per-recipient engagement report, a CSV or the events with no recipient. Input tips: send the raw export text itself as events, never a file name or link; the events field lists the shapes read. Add recipients_csv or campaigns_csv only when the user gives them. Rules default to: dedup on, a 14 day window, machine opens as impressions only, bounce clears delivered. Set a rule only when the user names a different window or rule. Returns: a per-send summary, up to 500 recipient rows (csv holds every row), up to 100 exceptions, parse_errors and the rules used. A file that mixes platforms is read event by event. Only for the user's own sends: it reads event types, times and ids, and reads or returns no IP address, user agent, device or location. Next step: when events_kept is 0 or parse_errors is not empty, show the errors and ask for the raw export. Not for: sending mail or calling a mail platform API.

campaigns_csv.description: Optional CSV text with a header row: deployment_key,deployment_code,campaign_name,client,deploy_date. deployment_key must equal the send key the report gives each send, such as newsletter:12, campaign:5:action:7, broadcast:3:action:9, transactional:4, sendgrid:<template id> or mailgun:<tag>; run the report once to read the keys from summary.

events.description: The pasted export text itself, not a file name or link, such as {"event_id":"e1","metric":"sent","timestamp":1789480800,"data":{"identifiers":{"id":"R-1"}}}. NDJSON (one event per line) or a JSON array. Read shapes: Customer.io (event_id, metric, timestamp, data.identifiers.id or email, data.delivery_id); SendGrid (flat email, event, timestamp, sg_event_id, sg_message_id); Mailgun (event, id, recipient, timestamp, tags, flat or inside "event-data"). Timestamps are unix seconds; milliseconds are converted. At most 20,000 events and 1,500,000 characters.

recipients_csv.description: Optional CSV text with a header row, then one row per recipient: recipient_id,email,external_id (external_id may be empty). Example: recipient_id,email,external_id\nR-1,ada@example.com,CRM-1001. Events join by recipient_id, then delivery id, then email. Without it every send is a row and nothing is an exception.

bounceClearsDelivered.description: A bounce sets delivered to 0. Default true.

clickSetsOpen.description: A counted click with no counted open sets unique open to 1. Default true.

dedup.description: Count each event id once. Default true.

dropMachineClicks.description: Link-scanner clicks are left out. Default true.

keepUnmatched.description: Keep rows with no recipient match. Default false. They still appear in exceptions.

machineOpensAsImpression.description: Apple privacy and prefetch opens count as impressions, not opens. Default true.

proxiedCountsAsOpen.description: Proxied opens that are not prefetched count as opens. Default true.

syntheticCountsAsOpen.description: Synthetic opens count as opens. Default true.

windowDays.description: Days after the send that opens and clicks count. Default 14.

windowOn.description: Apply the time window. Default true.

name: engagement_report

csv.description: Every recipient row as CSV with a header row.

duplicates_removed.description: Events dropped because their event id was already seen.

effects.description: How many events each rule changed.

bounceReset.description: Rows whose delivered was set to 0 by a bounce.

clickOpen.description: Rows whose unique open was set by a click.

late.description: Opens and clicks after the window, left out.

machineOpens.description: Machine (prefetched) opens kept as impressions only.

events_in.description: Email events read from the export.

events_kept.description: Events left after removing repeated event ids.

exceptions.description: Events with no recipient match, at most 100. Empty without recipients_csv.

items.description: An event that matched no row of recipients_csv.

deployment_key.description: The send key of the event.

email.description: The email on the event, or empty.

event_id.description: The event id from the export.

metric.description: The event type, such as sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced or unsubscribed.

reason.description: Why the event is an exception.

delivery_id.description: Events matched through a delivery id seen with a known recipient.

parse_errors.description: Lines or values that are not valid JSON, at most 20. Show them and ask for the raw export when events_kept is 0.

platform.description: Platform read from the first event; email when it is not known, none when no email event was found.

recipients.description: Per-recipient rows, at most 500; csv holds every row.

campaign_name.description: Campaign name from campaigns_csv or the export.

delivered.description: 1 when delivered, 0 after a bounce when bounceClearsDelivered is on.

deploy_date.description: Deploy date from campaigns_csv, or empty.

deployment_code.description: Code from campaigns_csv, or the send key when there is none.

deployment_key.description: The send key, such as newsletter:12; it joins to campaigns_csv.

first_open.description: Time of the first counted open (ISO 8601 UTC), or empty.

impressions.description: Open events inside the window, human and machine; machine opens stop here and do not reach opens.

notes.description: Which rules changed this row, separated by semicolons.

recipient_id.description: recipient_id from recipients_csv, or empty when unmatched.

sent.description: 1 when a sent event was seen.

unique_click.description: 1 when at least one click counted.

unique_open.description: 1 when an open counted, or when a click counted and clickSetsOpen is on.

unsubscribe.description: 1 when the recipient unsubscribed or reported spam.

rules.description: The rules this report used, defaults filled in.

bounceClearsDelivered.description: A bounce sets delivered to 0. Default true.

clickSetsOpen.description: A counted click with no counted open sets unique open to 1. Default true.

dedup.description: Count each event id once. Default true.

dropMachineClicks.description: Link-scanner clicks are left out. Default true.

keepUnmatched.description: Keep rows with no recipient match. Default false. They still appear in exceptions.

machineOpensAsImpression.description: Apple privacy and prefetch opens count as impressions, not opens. Default true.

proxiedCountsAsOpen.description: Proxied opens that are not prefetched count as opens. Default true.

syntheticCountsAsOpen.description: Synthetic opens count as opens. Default true.

windowDays.description: Days after the send that opens and clicks count. Default 14.

windowOn.description: Apply the time window. Default true.

summary.description: One row per send. Sum its recipients for the full row count.

campaign_name.description: Campaign name, or a label such as Newsletter 12.

click_rate.description: unique_click over delivered (or sent), such as 3.5%, or -.

click_to_open.description: unique_click over unique_open, such as 8.3%, or -.

deployment_code.description: Code from campaigns_csv, or the send key.

deployment_key.description: The send key, such as newsletter:12.

open_rate.description: unique_open over delivered (or sent when none delivered), such as 42.0%, or - when there is no base.

recipients.description: Recipient rows for this send, before the 500-row cut of recipients.

title: Build an email engagement report
